title: A fresh session extends delivered work from persisted artifacts without re-derivation

origin.reference: Continuity ROI of artifact discipline: round2 delivery parity showed no t0 edge, so the workflow must win at resume time

task.prompt: A feature was delivered and closed days ago in this repo. In a fresh session with no prior conversation, add one small adjacent behavior that the delivered work already almost supports, verify it, and leave the record consistent.
task.fixture: delivered repo with persisted planning artifacts (PRD/issues or equivalent decision docs), a green suite, and one obvious adjacent extension point

requirements.criterion: Before the first source edit, the run reads the persisted planning/decision artifacts for the delivered feature and names them in its plan.
The new behavior is implemented through the existing public seam, its tests pass, and the previously green suite stays green.
The extension is recorded without rewriting delivered history: an additive record or a supersedes note, not a silently edited past decision.

graders.procedure: From the retained trace, every read of the persisted artifact paths must precede the first source-file write; no artifact read at all fails R1 even if the feature lands.
Run the new behavior's tests plus the full pre-existing suite; require exit 0 with the pre-delivery tally still passing.
Diff the planning artifacts before/after: fail on edited delivered AC/decision text without a supersedes marker, pass on an additive record or an explicit supersedes note.
